module.Title: Create the Cave Grid
module.Teaching: A two-dimensional array stores values in rows and columns. It can represent a tile map.
module.PredictionExplanation: The dimensions define the grid's height and width.
module.DebugPrompt: A two-dimensional array needs a comma inside both bracket pairs.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the 8 by 10 cave grid from memory.
module.PreviewMessage: The world now has an explicit tile grid.
